html:
Messier 33 is a spiral galaxy located in the constellation Triangulum, 3 million light-years from earth. It is part of the Local Group of galaxies, along with the Milky Way, the Andromeda Galaxy and about thirty other galaxies of lesser importance.


For this photo, here are the technical parameters
Date:  2010/11/12
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 + f4.5 reducer - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software
Temperature 0 to -5 deg celsius
Site: At home
16 exposures of 10 minutes for 160 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
Calibration/Registration/Integration and processing in PixInsight
